title: Databricks Data Engineer Roadmap
subtitle: A structured learning path from Data Engineering fundamentals to advanced Databricks development, Apache Spark, Delta Lake and real-world data pipelines.

roadmap.title: SQL Fundamentals
roadmap.description: Build a strong SQL foundation before working with Databricks and modern data platforms.

roadmap.title: Python for Data Engineering
roadmap.description: Learn Python concepts commonly used for data engineering, automation and Spark development.

roadmap.title: Data Engineering Fundamentals
roadmap.description: Understand the core concepts behind modern data engineering systems and pipelines.

roadmap.title: Databricks Fundamentals
roadmap.description: Understand the Databricks platform, workspace and core components used by data engineers.

roadmap.title: Apache Spark Fundamentals
roadmap.description: Learn Apache Spark fundamentals for distributed data processing and large-scale analytics.

roadmap.title: PySpark Development
roadmap.description: Build practical data transformation skills using PySpark inside Databricks.

roadmap.title: Delta Lake
roadmap.description: Learn Delta Lake and its role in building reliable lakehouse data platforms.

roadmap.title: Lakehouse Architecture
roadmap.description: Understand how Databricks combines data lakes and data warehouses through the lakehouse architecture.

roadmap.title: Data Ingestion
roadmap.description: Learn how to ingest structured and semi-structured data into Databricks.

roadmap.title: Databricks Workflows & Jobs
roadmap.description: Build and automate production data pipelines using Databricks Jobs and Workflows.

roadmap.title: Streaming & Real-Time Data
roadmap.description: Learn how to process continuously arriving data using streaming technologies and Spark.

roadmap.title: Unity Catalog & Security
roadmap.description: Understand data governance, access control and security within the Databricks platform.

roadmap.title: Performance Optimization
roadmap.description: Optimize Spark workloads and Databricks compute for better performance and cost efficiency.

roadmap.title: Data Pipeline Development
roadmap.description: Design complete production-style ETL and ELT pipelines using Databricks.

roadmap.title: Cloud Data Integration
roadmap.description: Connect Databricks with modern cloud storage and cloud data engineering services.

roadmap.title: Real-World Databricks Projects
roadmap.description: Apply Databricks, Spark and data engineering skills through practical projects.

roadmap.title: Certification & Interview Preparation
roadmap.description: Prepare for Databricks Data Engineer certification and data engineering interviews.
